fact: The director of the identity and registration department of the General Administration of Civil Registry says the civil registry database was fully restored after war damage to infrastructure and the paper archive, paper registers remain a reference for cases not available electronically, and an online application system for young children has begun.
title: السجل المدني يتجاوز خسائر الحرب باستعادة قاعدة البيانات كاملة ويبدأ التقديم الإلكتروني للأطفال
